title: oenothera laciniata subsp. pubescens
intro: Oenothera laciniata subsp. pubescens, commonly known as the fragrant evening primrose, is a species of flowering plant in the evening primrose family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating menstrual cramps, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, sedative, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Oenothera laciniata subsp. pubescens may be attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health.
